content: Vercel function duration: Hobby default 10s cap, Pro 60s default (configurable to 300s classic). Fluid Compute (now default for new projects) raises Pro/Enterprise ceiling to 800s, with a 30-min beta. Duration counts streamed response time; overrun => 504 FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT. maxDuration set per-function in code or vercel.json. Cold starts and per-invocation compute cost still apply; long LLM/STT calls on a single /api/db endpoint risk both timeout and cost blowout.
